title: The Last Current
author: Beatrix Almeida
blurb: Yara Halloran, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
